adaptive.timeZone: user local; runtime supplies authoritative time
adaptive.weatherNotes: Rain-on-water only near water. Thunder only explicit distant-thunder event. Fog reduces melody gain, not note count. Snow suppresses rhythm, not a new score.

spatial.distanceUnit: world units; tune to scene scale

transitions.strategy: start destination on an 8-bar boundary of source; destination starts at sample 0; overlap for source crossfadeSeconds
transitions.sameTrackIndoor: keep playhead; change environment bus only unless explicitly selecting home arrangement
transitions.stemSync: one shared AudioContext start time and identical loop frame range
transitions.seasonProbabilityPolicy: choose next track at a musical boundary; do not toggle tracks each frame

silence.at: after full loop/phrase; fade out over 2 bars

performance.decodeCache: Promise<AudioBuffer> keyed by asset id; bounded LRU
performance.preload: current main OR current four stems; active ambience; character hot-set
performance.mobileNote: Decoded float32 stereo uses frames * 2 * 4 bytes; four 96-second stems use about 129 MiB, before ambience. Prefer main mix on memory-limited devices.
